class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleHorns
class.description: [RailVehicleHorns] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleHorns].

method.description: The horn pressed: 1 the low one, -1 the high one, 0 none.
